user.title: Anova Precision Oven
user.description: How do you sign in to the Anova app?

menu_options.paste: Advanced: paste a login key (Google, Apple or Facebook sign-in)

login.title: Sign in to Anova
login.description: Your password is used once to get a login key and is never saved.

data_description.api_key: Anova Precision Oven reads this public key from Anova's website. It could not be found this time, so paste it here if you have it.

paste.title: Paste a login key
paste.description: For accounts that sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook. Paste the refresh token from your Anova web session.

data_description.api_key: Anova Precision Oven reads this public key from Anova's website. It could not be found this time, so paste it here if you have it.

personal.title: Personal token (optional)
personal.description: Optional. The personal token from the Anova app is the backup for Stop: it is used to stop the oven if the normal login stops working. You can leave this empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Anova again
reauth_confirm.description: Anova no longer accepts the saved login. Enter your email and password again. The password is not saved.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong email or password, or the login key is not valid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anova. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_api_key: Anova did not accept its web key. Paste a current one into the key box, or try again later.
error.no_api_key: The Anova web key could not be found. Paste it into the key box.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Anova Precision Oven is already set up.

login_failed.title: Anova login stopped working during a cook
login_failed.description: Anova no longer accepts the saved login while the oven may be cooking, so Home Assistant cannot see the oven. Check the oven, then sign in again from the Anova Precision Oven integration. A saved stop time still goes out, through the personal token if you added one.

stop_failed.title: The oven may not have stopped
stop_failed.description: Home Assistant tried to stop the oven at the end of a cook and could not confirm that it stopped. The oven may still be heating, so please check it now, and press Stop on the oven if it is.

start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Starts a cook on the oven. If a cook is running, it is stopped first. Every cook has a maximum time and Home Assistant stops the oven at the end. Returns the new cook's id.

temperature_f.name: Temperature
temperature_f.description: Oven temperature in Fahrenheit, up to 480.

probe_f.name: Probe temperature
probe_f.description: Food probe target in Fahrenheit. Not tested on this oven yet, so it is refused for now.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Cook timer in whole minutes. Leave empty for a cook with no timer (it ends at the maximum time).

elements.name: Heating elements
elements.description: Which elements are on: top, bottom, rear. At least one. The default is rear.

steam_percent.name: Steam
steam_percent.description: Steam as a percentage, 0 to 100. Leave empty for none. Not together with humidity.

humidity.name: Humidity
humidity.description: Relative humidity as a percentage, 0 to 100. The oven temperature can then go up to 212 F. Not together with steam.

sous_vide.name: Sous vide
sous_vide.description: Sous vide mode: 100% humidity, up to 212 F.

timer_mode.name: Timer mode
timer_mode.description: When the timer starts. Immediately, When Preheated and Manually work. When Food Detected and When Food Removed are not tested yet and are refused.

vent.name: Vent
vent.description: Exhaust vent: closed, open-mid or open-max.

max_minutes.name: Maximum minutes
max_minutes.description: The longest this cook may run before Home Assistant stops the oven. Default is 3 hours, or the timer plus a margin.

temperature_c.name: Temperature (Celsius)
temperature_c.description: The same as the Fahrenheit field, in Celsius. Kept so old values convert easily.

probe_c.name: Probe temperature (Celsius)
probe_c.description: The same as the Fahrenheit field, in Celsius. Kept so old values convert easily.

target_temperature_celsius.name: Target temperature (Celsius, old name)
target_temperature_celsius.description: The old integration's name for the oven temperature in Celsius.

target_temperature_fahrenheit.name: Target temperature (Fahrenheit, old name)
target_temperature_fahrenheit.description: The old integration's name for the oven temperature in Fahrenheit.

temperature_probe_celsius.name: Probe temperature (Celsius, old name)
temperature_probe_celsius.description: The old integration's name for the probe target in Celsius.

temperature_probe_fahrenheit.name: Probe temperature (Fahrenheit, old name)
temperature_probe_fahrenheit.description: The old integration's name for the probe target in Fahrenheit.

target_humidity.name: Target humidity (old name)
target_humidity.description: The old integration's field, meaning steam percent unless sous vide is on, and then humidity.

heating_top.name: Top element (old name)
heating_top.description: The old integration's switch for the top element.

heating_bottom.name: Bottom element (old name)
heating_bottom.description: The old integration's switch for the bottom element.

heating_rear.name: Rear element (old name)
heating_rear.description: The old integration's switch for the rear element.

timer.name: Timer (old name)
timer.description: The old integration's timer as a duration, in whole minutes. Zero means no timer.

start_custom_cook.name: Start custom cook
start_custom_cook.description: Starts a cook from stages written out in full, sent to the oven as written. Returns the new cook's id.

config.name: Stages
config.description: The stages as JSON text: a list of stages in the oven's format.

max_minutes.name: Maximum minutes
max_minutes.description: The longest this cook may run before Home Assistant stops the oven. Default is 3 hours.

stop_cook.name: Stop cook
stop_cook.description: Stops the oven. With no cook id it is always sent. With a cook id it stops only that cook, so a safety stop in a script cannot end a later cook.

cook_id.name: Cook id
cook_id.description: The id that start_cook returned. Leave empty to stop whatever is running.

update_cook.name: Update cook
update_cook.description: Changes the running cook's active stage. Only the fields you give are changed.

temperature_c.name: Temperature (Celsius)
temperature_c.description: The same as the Fahrenheit field, in Celsius. Kept so old values convert easily.

steam_percent.name: Steam
steam_percent.description: New steam percentage. For cooks started with steam.

humidity.name: Humidity
humidity.description: New relative humidity. For cooks started with humidity or sous vide.

vent.name: Vent
vent.description: New vent position: closed, open-mid or open-max.

elements.name: Heating elements
elements.description: Which elements are on: top, bottom, rear. At least one.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Release a timer that is waiting for a manual start.

next_stage.name: Next stage
next_stage.description: Moves the running cook on to one of its stages.

stage_id.name: Stage id
stage_id.description: The id of the stage to start.

update_stages.name: Update stages
update_stages.description: Replaces the running cook's stages with stages written out in full, sent as written.

config.name: Stages
config.description: The stages as JSON text: a list of stages in the oven's format.

trigger_type.cook_target_reached: The oven reached its target temperature
